name: md2html-api
description: Node.js SDK (fetch-based, zero deps) for the MD2HTML Markdown-to-HTML micropayment API.
author: dcn13l

scripts.test: node -e "const {MD2HTMLClient}=require('./md2html-client');const c=new MD2HTMLClient();c.health().then(r=>{console.log('health ok:',JSON.stringify(r).slice(0,120));return c.convert('# Hi **world**');}).then(r=>{console.log('convert ok, html head:',String(r.html).slice(0,80));}).catch(e=>{console.error('FAIL',e.message);process.exit(1);});"
